purpose: Uniformly shrink each case-23 base coil around the magnetic-axis point nearest its centroid, preserving its Fourier shape, then test direct-data Adam repair.

shrink_scan.mapping: For base coil j, p_scaled=a_j+scale*(p-a_j), where a_j is the verified magnetic-axis point nearest the coil centroid.
shrink_scan.shape_contract: The order-16 Fourier curve undergoes one exact similarity transform; no pointwise axis projection is used.
shrink_scan.surface_role: fixed geometric reference from the source field; not re-solved after coil scaling

repair.selection: Prefer scale 0.4 when it is valid and remains outside the fixed reference surface; fill remaining slot with the next most compact valid outside candidate.
repair.axis_handling: global candidate screening followed by strict selected-axis continuation
repair.parallelism: independent one-GPU Students jobs run concurrently
